en: Right then! So the Mistress had come back for a second go at the hives but Brann was having none of that nonsense! Before the melee began, she started talking to something or someone. Crazier still, she started chanting in a language none of us had ever heard.
ARRRRRGH! He got me!
Burp! Hon, that was really good. Not only do you know how to catch a fish but you sure do know how to cook one.

It is very kind of you to ask after our needs, $c. It would appear though that we have collected all of the runecloth bandages we feel we'll need of the war. May I ask that you inquire around with some of the other collectors and lend them your aid if needed? Ancestors watch over you.
Poor little donkey. It was only a wee lad.

On the northern dock, you can board a ship that will carry you to Rut'theran Village and Darnassus.  From the southern dock, you can find passage across the Great Sea to Menethil Harbor on Khaz Modan.  Safe journeys to you!

A closer inspection of the pylon leads you to find a small table containing blue, yellow, and green crystals arranged in what seems like a specific formation.$B$BA large blue circle of crystals is flanked on either side by a smaller circle of yellow crystals and another of green crystals.$B$BYou carefully take note of the colors of the crystals, knowing that J.D. would be very interested in hearing about what you have found.
An Alchemy trainer is what you need?  Well, I just came from there, I did.  Ye'll find Ms. Berryfizz over in Tinker Town where the gnomes gather.
Thank you, $n.  You have tempered the cold rage in my heart.
Where is your Medallion of Station, little one?  You may not speak with a Duke without proof of title...
%s emerges to protect the Fathom Stone!

I was invited to visit Dalaran on behalf of the Cenarion Circle. I find this place equal parts wondrous... and unsettling.

As for you, young $C--If you have not yet done so, seek out Sheldras Moontree in Stormwind. He will teach you to reach the Cenarion Circle enclave at Moonglade.
An honorable... death.
I'm out of the building again.  Now I'll move one more waypoint...
Lysta, summon in the captives.
Let's get out of here, $n. I'm ready now!
You said you would have it back. What does that mean?
What was that? Did you hear something?
Training you further is beyond my abilities. Speak to Telonis in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. He is always glad to help talented students.
Be patient, $n. The torch is almost complete.
There's the mystical tome I was looking for.
You are not trying to kill the anvil with your hammer, you are trying to create a weapon to kill your foes with. Let me show you what you are doing wrong.
Our oldest clutch of dragons are still far from maturity, but with patience and study, we are confident the dragonflight will soon be ready.

No one get past me and threaten da king!  Ungh, take it!!
Wanna race again? Best two out of three!
Shine yer armor for a copper.
What do you mean you don't know how to use an axe?
Welp the fish ain't bitin' no more so I might as start gutting and cleaning what I did catch today.

You learn quickly, that is not a bad thing. Just be sure to do the job right, as long as it takes to do so. Now, I fear I must send you to Snarl to learn more. Learn what he can teach, but do not listen to his angry words. He gets that way when Saru's daughters laugh at him.
We support mystical tradesmen by carrying a limited selection of arcane trade supplies. Are you looking for something in particular?
